Smart-home upgrades-including Google security, keyless entry, and customizable lighting-let you live effortlessly.  Recent renovations shine throughout: refinished hardwood floors, fresh paint, updated lighting, and new upstairs flooring offer a move-in-ready experience that feels brand new.
